2238.note: Bethlen Miklos to Gyulafi Laszlo, Teremi 13 August 1667 (not 1666 as in the lead and Lang's row), has a printed postscript of 137 numbers in Jankovics's edition, nos. 70 pp. 185-186, with no decipherment printed there and Lang marking it 'feloldatlan'.

seen.where: Jankovics J. (ed.), Bethlen Miklos levelei I-II (RMPE 6, Budapest 1987), vol. 1 no. 70 (printed pp. 185-186; PDF page 187 of https://szovegtar.iti.mta.hu/site/assets/files/24889/rmpe06-bethlen_1657--1716_1987-1.pdf, text layer read 5 Nov 2026), with the editor's note on PDF p. 631 (autograph, OL P 659, 29. cs. 740); Lang 2015 repertory row C.BethM.03 on p. 281 of https://real-d.mtak.hu/922/7/dc_758_13_doktori_mu.pdf.
seen.extent: Six lines of numbers, about 137 tokens (values 2 to 53, many repeated), after a short clear Hungarian letter dated 'Teremi 13 Augusto 1667'; the edition's transcription (OCR text layer, a few misreadings possible), original not seen.
seen.cipher: Printed letter text: clear body saying he sends an 'Includalt Mese' (included fable) and signs 'Teremi 13 Augusto 1667', followed by the six lines of numbers ('53 2 30 23 30 2 42 52 30 23 2 52 43 23 50 12 ...'); the editor's notes on no. 70 give only the shelfmark and a comment on the content, and no plaintext or key for the number block. The date in the lead and in Lang ('1666. 08. 13.') is wrong: the edition heads the letter 'Teremi, 1667. augusztus 13.' Lang: 'magyar homof., szamok; feloldatlan; reszleges, csak a postscriptum' (Hungarian, homophonic numbers, undeciphered, partial, postscript only).
